items.q: Do I need to log in to use AIVisa?
items.a: No. You can use it right away without logging in.
Currently, everything is free to use.
Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese. We plan to expand progressively.

items.q: Can I save or print a page as PDF?
items.a: Yes. On supported pages, click the "PDF" button in the top-right to save or print with one click.

items.q: Can I fully rely on the visa information and AI answers on this site?
items.a: All content and AI answers are provided for reference only and do not constitute legal advice or a final determination. Policies and practices may change, and applicability varies by individual circumstances. Always verify with the latest official sources before proceeding, and consider consulting a professional (e.g., gyoseishoshi) when necessary.
